Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using FLAG-tagged KBTBD4 to identify interactors. While the study focuses on ubiquitylation, the MS analysis described in the 'Sample preparation for mass spectrometry proteomics' section is a global identification of interactors (AP-MS) rather than a targeted ubiquitylome/diGly enrichment run. The ubiquitylation assays mentioned in the results were performed via immunoblotting, not LC-MS/MS.
